scope: Independent read-only scientific-content and visual-layout review of the completed main manuscript; material issues within the stated coverage.

full_resolution_focus: Raw-span statements and deterministic closure proposition/proof
Direct readout definition and generic magnitude corollary
Complete central-study protocol, primary and aggregate tables, and descriptive condition figure
Dense complete algebra/ridge proofs and retained residual-readout appendix

scientific_checks.primary_results: Displayed P/G 69.20%, K/P 10.46%, K/R 0.03%, linear K/P -1.11%, and 3/4 primary decisions align with audited analysis at the displayed precision.
scientific_checks.inference: Primary P-selected shared-bank family remains distinct from secondary independently selected caps. Independent units are 32 repetition aggregates; upper-gap sign and four-claim Bonferroni quantile are stated consistently. Linear noninferiority is not presented as a linear improvement.
scientific_checks.heterogeneity: Law/noise and horizon observations agree with inspected analysis tables and are labeled descriptive. The figure shows the mixed enrichment outcomes without adding confirmatory claims.
scientific_checks.representation_and_dynamics: Product-simplex raw memberships are distinguished from signed enrichments and transformed decoder inputs. Finite direct-readout utility is not presented as sufficiency, Markov closure, compression, general KAHM superiority or validated autonomous dynamics.
scientific_checks.mathematics: Raw-span equality/distinctness and deterministic exact-closure claims retain their assumptions. The direct-readout bound is explicitly a generic specialization of the existing centered-ridge proposition with an unpenalized intercept and gives no accuracy or rollout guarantee.
scientific_checks.historical_evidence: Prior residual and policy findings remain separately scoped; unsuccessful policy superiority and the adverse descriptive natural panel remain explicit. No pooling of old observations into the new confidence family was identified.
scientific_checks.provenance: Printed source commit 2b7d19b5 and result commit 65ecf679 are distinct. Corrected full freeze-digest location PUBLICATION.json and B replay maximum rounded to 1.20e-11 are present. Audit scope excludes independently reimplementing partition k-means and physical-law integration.

layout_checks.result: No material clipping, table or equation collisions, unreadable central display, blank page, or defective page break identified.
layout_checks.central_tables_and_figure: Primary upper bounds, decisions and aggregate SD columns are legible; figure labels, legends, markers and caption fit within the page.
layout_checks.dense_proofs: Inspected equations and proof paragraphs fit the text area without collisions or lost symbols.
layout_checks.references_and_appendices: Reference continuation and appendix transitions are readable. Table-only pages and a short final page are ordinary float/end-of-document layouts.

limitations: All pages received contact-sheet inspection; only the listed pages received full-resolution visual inspection.
This review does not independently rerun the production experiment or replace the numerical audit.
No TeX compilation, manuscript edit, frozen-source edit or external publication was performed by this reviewer.
The verdict concerns material scientific and layout issues identified within this review, not a guarantee of external replication or journal acceptance.
